prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: 16 new in-between character sprites for an existing Korean historical fantasy tower-defense animation. Image1 is the exact approved hero appearance and pose continuity reference. Generate ONLY 16 NEW sprites, not its six-row layout.
Character: Admiral Yi Sun-sin, small stylized 3D painted game character with navy scale armor, ivory trim, a dark NAVY cloak with crimson inside, tall long RED helmet plume, black moustache and beard, ONE wooden recurved bow and one back quiver. Preserve the exact reference clothes, face, body proportions, armor details, weapon hand and colors. Do not turn his navy cloak red.
Mandatory output: FOUR columns and FOUR rows of isolated complete FULL BODY characters on truly transparent alpha. All 16 same scale and fixed isometric overhead camera. At least 8% completely transparent spacing between silhouettes, no shadows or floor or effects or labels. Column directions for EVERY row match image1: 1 front-right, 2 back-right, 3 back-left, 4 front-left. Columns3-4 must be actual correct leftward views, not duplicate rightward characters.
The four rows are distinct new animation phases:
Row1: Walking compression after the anatomical LEFT foot lands in front, BEFORE the existing passing pose. Left boot firmly carries weight ahead, RIGHT heel rises behind, knees softly compressed, upright torso, empty right hand lowered, bow held relaxed in left hand.
Row2: Opposite walking compression: anatomical RIGHT foot planted in front, LEFT heel rises behind. Clearly swap leading legs from row1 in all four directions. Bow stays in the same anatomical LEFT hand. Small matching cloak follow-through.
Row3: Early arrow release follow-through: the arrow has already left and is NOT visible, bow held forward with relaxed string in anatomical LEFT hand, anatomical RIGHT drawing hand just released near jaw and beginning to move back a little. Two arms, two hands only. Eyes at target, legs braced, matching reference row5 but a little earlier. NO arrow remaining, no nocked arrow, no muzzle flash.
Row4: Final relaxed recovery just before returning to idle: bow lowers close to side in LEFT hand, RIGHT hand approaches natural lowered position, both boots grounded, shoulders relax, cloak settles. Match identity and idle silhouette from reference row1.
Style/medium: polished painterly stylized 3D, finely sculpted rounded form, soft cool shaded navy fabric and restrained warm gold highlights. Match reference rendering; no new chibi proportions, no flat vector or pixel art. No extra limbs, no extra weapons, no random accessories, no checkerboard, no text.
Technical framing correction: MAKE EACH CHARACTER SMALLER, about 65 percent of its cell height. Leave a LARGE CLEAR TRANSPARENT BORDER above all helmet plumes and below all boots, and around all capes and bows. The first row must start well below the top canvas edge. NO helmet/plume/boot/weapon edge can touch the canvas boundary or another character. All four rows and all columns have ample transparent gutters. Do not crop the red plume.
